Gate 3 revise from the person, verbatim:
revise: Drawing on any page except the first is broken in the real app. On a new page, a rectangle drag leaves a 0×0 rectangle (the same drag on Page 1 gives 150×131), and those shapes disappear on reload because Excalidraw drops invisibly small elements on save. Cause: Scene.insertElementAtIndex (packages/element/src/Scene.ts:529-534) and replaceAllElements (Scene.ts:432-440) stamp pageId by swapping a new element for a copy ({ ...element, pageId }), so App.tsx keeps resizing the original object during the drag while the scene holds the copy. Fix: set pageId on the element object itself in both places (for example Object.assign(element, { pageId: this.activePageId })) instead of copying, so the scene and App.tsx share one object; this covers every creation path (shapes, text, freedraw, lines, arrows, images, frames). I checked that change in the dev app: the same drag on a new page then gives a 150×131 rectangle that survives a reload. Add a jsdom test in packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx that adds a second page, draws a rectangle with UI.clickTool("rectangle") and mouse.down/mouse.up, and asserts the element's width and height are non-zero and its pageId is the second page's id.

On disk now the two copies are at packages/element/src/Scene.ts lines 434-440 (replaceAllElements: `? { ...el, pageId: this.activePageId }`) and 528-535 (insertElementsAtIndex: `: { ...element, pageId: this.activePageId },`). Change only these two sites: set pageId on the element object itself (Object.assign) and keep the same element reference in the array. Leave every other line unchanged.
